label: SB 6 Buttons
description: A single-breasted waistcoat with six buttons, producing a high, closed front with closely spaced buttons for a fuller, more buttoned-up look. The increased button count requires the front to sit higher for even spacing and lends a vintage or fashion-forward character. On six-button cutaway styles the bottom button does not align and is left open.
